## Turning marketing questions into clear, useful evidence {.hero-heading}

I am pursuing an MS in Digital Marketing & Analytics at Cal Poly Pomona. My coursework connects marketing measurement, customer research, and reproducible reporting so audiences can understand what the evidence supports and what still needs to be tested.

I am interested in marketing analytics and customer insights roles, helping teams ask better questions, evaluate digital activity, and communicate practical next steps.
